wl.title: Web Log
wl.description: Analyze application and server traffic trends by day, week, or month with live admin logs
wl.help.title: Web Log — User guide
wl.err.invalid_mode: Unsupported granularity "{mode}". Use day, week, or month.
wl.err.invalid_group_by: Unsupported breakdown mode "{group_by}". Use auto or host.
wl.err.invalid_date_range: Start date must be on or before end date.
wl.err.range_too_large: Date range cannot exceed {max} days for this granularity.
wl.err.forbidden_admin: Only system administrators (T_USER_ALL Type = admin) can view the live Redis web log.
wl.err.live_unavailable: The live Redis web log is unavailable because Redis is not configured on this server.
wl.tour.dates.title: Date range and presets
wl.tour.dates.text: Pick any start and end date or use quick presets (7D, 30D, 90D, 12M). Queries use standard calendar days, ISO weeks (Mon–Sun), and calendar months.
wl.tour.mode.title: Day, Week, or Month
wl.tour.mode.text: Switch between daily, weekly, and monthly trend views. Visitor Count always reflects distinct IP addresses within each period.
wl.tour.groupby.title: Stack breakdown mode
wl.tour.groupby.text: Switch stacked bars between App / Tools (apps when All is selected, tools/categories when one app is selected) and By Server to compare traffic across hosts.
wl.tour.filters.title: App, Server, and Tools filters
wl.tour.filters.text: Filter by application, one or more servers (blank historical hosts map to prod_eng), specific tools/categories, or exclude background idle traffic.
wl.tour.kpis.title: Summary metrics
wl.tour.kpis.text: Headline totals for the active filter window: total actions, deduplicated unique visitors across the entire range, peak period, and active series count.
wl.tour.chart.title: Interactive trend chart
wl.tour.chart.text: Stacked bars show Action Count (left axis) and the orange line shows unique Visitor Count (right axis). Click a bar to drill down, toggle legend items, zoom, or export an image.
wl.tour.breakdown.title: Full breakdown table
wl.tour.breakdown.text: Lists every matching app, tool, or server with exact actions, share, and range-wide unique visitors — including items folded into Others on the chart. Click any row to filter.
wl.tour.live.title: Live Redis Web Log (Admin)
wl.tour.live.text: Visible only to system administrators (T_USER_ALL Type = admin). Displays the newest entries directly from the Redis web_log list with keyword, server, and level filters plus optional auto-refresh.
wl.ui.no_data: No web log records match the selected date range and filters.
wl.ui.range_clamped: Date range was shortened to {max} days for the daily view.
wl.ui.drill_hint_app: Click a bar to view its tools
wl.ui.drill_hint_category: Click a bar to filter by tool
wl.ui.drill_hint_host: Click a bar to filter by server
wl.ui.live_empty: No live log entries match the current filter.
